svg.title: HospitalSystem AWS infrastructure
svg.desc: Users reach app.hospitalsyst.cc through Cloudflare DNS and an internet-facing ALB that terminates TLS with an ACM certificate and sends /api and / to backend and frontend pods in a private EKS cluster. The backend reaches Neon PostgreSQL through the NAT gateways. GitHub Actions assumes IAM roles over OIDC: one pushes images to ECR, the other sends an SSM command to an ops instance, the only way into the private EKS API.
svg.text: AWS Load Balancer Controller: manages the ALB (IRSA)
scan on push · keeps the latest 30 · KMS-encrypted
VPC, subnets, NAT + internet gateways, VPC endpoints,
